name: CASP Cohort Study Checklist
license_note: Questions are consolidated paraphrases of the official checklist. The official wording is linked, not bundled.
notes: CASP questions are answered yes / can't tell / no and CASP defines no scoring or overall judgement, so none is derived. The domain list consolidates the official sections; consult the linked checklist for the full question set.

domains.name: Clearly focused issue
domains.short_prompt: Whether the study states its population, exposure, outcome, and results clearly enough to appraise.

domains.name: Similar groups from the same population
domains.short_prompt: Whether the exposed and unexposed groups were similar and recruited from the same population at the same time.

domains.name: Exposure measured similarly
domains.short_prompt: Whether exposure was measured the same way in both groups, with quantified exposure and blind assessment where feasible.

domains.name: Confounders identified and controlled
domains.short_prompt: Whether all important confounders were identified and strategies to deal with them were appropriate.

domains.name: Follow-up complete and long enough
domains.short_prompt: Whether the follow-up was long enough for outcomes, sufficiently complete, and losses explained.

domains.name: Outcome measurement valid and reliable
domains.short_prompt: Whether outcomes were measured in a way that was valid, reliable, and blind to exposure status.

domains.name: Precise results
domains.short_prompt: Whether the results are precise — effect estimates with confidence intervals and appropriate statistical tests.

domains.name: Dose-response pattern
domains.short_prompt: Whether the results show a dose-response pattern if the exposure is one that could plausibly have one.

domains.name: Conclusions justified
domains.short_prompt: Whether the conclusions follow from the results and acknowledge confounding, bias, and imprecision.
